subject: docs/coop/artifacts/platform-tcb-contract.v10.json
headMovementDisposition: PASS: HEAD remained at the dispatched D-114 commit.

shouldFix.title: The mandatory exact-volume comparison is asserted as retained but has no retained run or event fields
evidence: sameVolume.retained says preselection records the volume identity and filesystem-type token and that step 3 compares both. No retained location or shape is named for that preselection record. retainedEventSchema adds observerProcessIdentity and mountNamespaceIdentity but no preselectionVolumeIdentity, observedVolumeIdentity, selected mountinfo record or macOS f_fsid, observed filesystem token, or exact nesting for any of them.

completePlatformProfileKey retains the selected filesystem-type member, but not the preselection volume identity. resolvedObjectIdentity is the class-specific authenticity identity and route is not defined to contain a contemporaneous volume observation. Neither field supplies the exact-volume equality that sameVolume decides.

evidenceJoin still checks only that each event matches the signed active-profile table. It does not require the recorded event's volume identity and type token to match the preselection values, and the Linux retargeting rule has no retained before/after record from which a reviewer can verify it.
shouldFix.impact: A trace can be complete under the listed schema and show enforcedOutcome=used without carrying evidence that the object stayed on the target volume or that a mount retarget did not occur. The new security-critical refusal is therefore not independently checkable from the retained qualification evidence DR-126 requires.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Give the qualification-run record a closed preselection filesystem observation containing the canonical verified-root identity, OS-tagged volume identity, and normalized filesystem-type token. Give each applicable later event closed observed-volume and observed-type fields, or define their exact nested path in existing fields. Extend evidenceJoin to require equality with the preselection values and retain the Linux record identity needed to prove the retargeting check. Define the macOS and Linux forms separately.

shouldFix.title: verifiedInstallRoot does not unambiguously serialize the tree root it is intended to identify
evidence: verifiedInstallRoot is the install-root path identity anchored at the signed full-tree closure root, while its serialization is a path relative to that same root. The relative path from a root to itself is ordinarily empty or '.', but empty and dot components are both forbidden.

The trailing-slash exception 'except the tree root itself' suggests a special root form, but no root token or leading-slash rule is named. '/' would supply a token but conflicts with the stated relative-path form; an empty string or '.' violates the explicit grammar. The canonicalization clause cannot remove this serialization ambiguity because it consumes the already serialized binding.
shouldFix.impact: Two carrier authors can encode the one required root as '/', empty, or '.' under different readings, or reject every root-valued binding. That is fail-closed, but it prevents a byte-identical signed preselection value and profile freeze from being reproducible.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Define one exact root representation and the leading-slash rule. For example, define a virtual root token '/' despite the otherwise root-relative grammar, or permit the empty path only for the tree root while continuing to reject empty components elsewhere. State how the signed relative token is joined to the verified host anchor before canonicalization.

shouldFix.title: mountNamespaceIdentity is required globally but has neither a Linux identity/equality form nor a macOS absence rule
evidence: The Linux namespace rule now points to retainedEventSchema.mountNamespaceIdentity, but no kernel observation source, value type, serialization, or equality binds that field to the named verifierPid and prevents PID reuse or observer replacement. observerProcessIdentity is likewise only a field label with no binding to the /proc/<verifierPid> read.

retainedEventSchema is shared by every slice profile and describes mountNamespaceIdentity as a preselection namespace that later events MUST equal. macOS has no corresponding mount-namespace observation and the schema gives no Linux-only required condition, macOS-absent form, or inapplicability representation.
shouldFix.impact: Linux producers can use inequivalent namespace identifiers while claiming the equality check, and macOS producers must either invent a value or omit an apparently required field. The recording site is repaired, but its cross-platform contract is still not deterministic.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Define OS-tagged conditional forms: on Linux, name the namespace identity observation, its stable serialized value, its binding to observerProcessIdentity, and exact equality; require it on the preselection/run record and applicable events. On macOS, require the field to be absent or carry one explicit inapplicable form. Give observerProcessIdentity the minimum stable binding needed to defeat PID reuse during the observation.

verdictBasis: REJECT: 0 blockers and 3 SHOULD-FIX. ACCEPT requires 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX.
conclusion: REJECT. V10 closes the v9 blocker and companion defect in substance, but the mandatory exact-volume comparison has no defined retained run/event representation, verifiedInstallRoot lacks one unambiguous tree-root token, and mountNamespaceIdentity lacks a Linux identity/equality form and macOS absence rule. DR-126 remains OPEN; no D-096 (A) grant, satisfaction, qualification, sealing, application, or implementation authority is created.
